QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Unfamiliar Faces
QuestInfo.0: Loha called you Kao, as well. Who's this Kao person?\nGo talk to Loha again.
QuestInfo.1: Loha told you to stop slacking off and go with Tess to get the item Sion wanted. Great...but who are Tess and Sion?\nGo talk to Tess next to the Altaire Barrier Stone on the left side of the camp.\n
QuestInfo.2: You went to see Tess, who protects the Altaire Barrier Stone.

0.0: Look what the snails dragged in! Where have you been? That baby's going to starve if you don't shape up and take this seriously.\r\n#L0##bI'm sorry... I don't understand. I'm new here...and I don't know who you are.#l\n#k
0.1: This is no time for jokes, Kao! Find Tess, and go get the thing Sion needs.\r\n#L0##bI really don't understand! Who is Kao?#l\n#k
0.2: I don't appreciate this at all, Kao. Go see Tess before I get really mad. Crawls with Balrog must be starving.\r\n#L0##b(Who do they think I am? Is there someone here that looks just like me?) Um...so...where is Tess?#l\n#k
0.3: Where do you think Tess would be? She's next to the Barrier Stone! Hurry up!

1.0: Hey Kao! Man, I'm bored. I heard you talking to Loha. You really like messing with her, huh?

npc.0: Go talk to Tess and do your job! Quit slacking!
